people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: For Yahweh has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.
translations.bsb: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
translations.kjv: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
translations.asv: For Jehovah hath built up Zion; He hath appeared in his glory.
